meta.title: KVKK Privacy Notice (demo) — booking-platform
meta.description: Demo privacy notice on the processing of personal data.

notice.title: Personal Data Protection Privacy Notice
notice.disclaimer: This text is for a portfolio/demo project and is not legal advice. For a real service it must be prepared by a legal professional.

controller.title: 1. Data controller
controller.body: Under Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 ("KVKK"), the data controller is the operator of this demo platform. No real payments are taken in the demo environment, and no real personal data should be entered.

data.title: 2. Personal data processed
data.identity: Identity and contact: first name, last name, email address.
data.transactions: Customer transactions: bookings, favorites, reviews, transfer transactions.
data.finance: Finance: tokens and transaction references returned by the payment provider (card numbers are not stored).
data.security: Transaction security: session cookies, IP address, request logs, fraud score.

purpose.title: 3. Purposes of processing and legal grounds
purpose.body: Data is processed on the legal grounds of establishing and performing the booking contract (KVKK Art. 5/2-c), fulfilling legal obligations (Art. 5/2-ç), legitimate interest in ensuring service security and preventing fraud (Art. 5/2-f), and, for analytics cookies, your explicit consent (Art. 5/1).

transfer.title: 4. Transfers
transfer.body: Data may be transferred only to the extent required by the service to the accommodation property (booking details), to the payment service provider and to legally authorized authorities. If AI features are running in live mode, prompt content is sent to the model provider in a form that does not contain personal data.

retention.title: 5. Retention period
retention.body: When you delete your account, personal fields are deleted or replaced with a pseudonym. Booking and payment records are kept in anonymized form due to legal retention obligations.

cookies.title: 6. Cookies
cookies.body: Essential cookies (session, security, language preference) are required for the service to work and are not subject to consent. Analytics cookies are used only if you give consent in the cookie banner. You can update your preference at any time with the "Change cookie preferences" button below.

rights.title: 7. Your rights (KVKK Art. 11)
rights.body: You have the right to learn whether your data is processed, to request information, and to rectification, erasure and objection. To download your data or delete your account, you can use the <link>Privacy and my data</link> page.

accountPage.title: Privacy and my data
accountPage.intro: You can exercise your rights under KVKK Art. 11 here.

center.deleted: Your account has been deleted. Redirecting you to the home page…
center.exportBody: Download a copy of the personal data associated with your account (profile, bookings, reviews, favorites) as JSON. The password hash is not exported.
center.deleteBody: Your personal fields are deleted or replaced with a pseudonym. Booking and payment records are kept in anonymised form because of legal retention obligations. This cannot be undone.
center.confirmTitle: Are you sure you want to permanently delete your account?
center.acknowledge: I understand that my upcoming bookings will be cancelled under their cancellation terms, my wallet credit will be deleted and this cannot be undone.
center.noticeLink: You can read how your data is processed in the <link>privacy notice</link>.

deleteEffects.title: When you delete your account:
deleteEffects.bookings: Your upcoming bookings are cancelled under the cancellation terms that applied when you booked. You may get no refund or only a partial refund.
deleteEffects.wallet: Credit and rewards in your wallet are deleted and cannot be used later.
deleteEffects.transfers: Booking transfer listings you have put up for sale are withdrawn.
deleteEffects.listings: If you are a host, your listings are taken offline.
deleteEffects.obligations: If, as a host, you have upcoming confirmed bookings, a pending payout or an open claim, you must resolve them first.

center.exportFailed: Could not download your data. Please try again.
center.deleteFailed: Could not delete your account. Please try again.

obligations.title: Your account cannot be deleted yet. Please resolve the following first:
